{{Quote|The Rebels had their chance... I gave them years to reclaim the galaxy!|Palpatine|<ref name="DE 2" />}}
The '''Dark Empire''', also referred to as the '''Empire Reborn''',<ref name="DE Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> was an empire located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and led by the reborn [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The Dark Empire itself was headquartered at the dark side stronghold known as [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. The new regime tried to reclaim the territory of the former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after it had succumbed to a [[Imperial Civil War|civil war]] and splintered into various opposing factions. Although this new power was formed when Palpatine revived himself in a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], it officially revealed itself in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], when Palpatine became strong enough to attack the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It fell apart less than a year later in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], upon Palpatine's final death on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], as well as the destruction of Byss, the stronghold of the Dark Empire.

The Dark Empire was openly run by [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] users, and the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] kept a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]], called the [[Dark Side Elite]], to carry out his will, similar to the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hands]] of the Galactic Empire. There were always seven of them, and once one died, another was immediately appointed. Despite being trained and empowered by the Emperor himself, the Elite took heavy casualties during [[Operation Shadow Hand]] and were wiped out by the end of it.

The Emperor intended to eventually use solely the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to run the Dark Empire, but had to use regular vehicles until that could be accomplished. His rule introduced a new line of [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] to take the place of the two [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]] his earlier Empire had. They were the [[Eclipse-class dreadnought|''Eclipse''-class dreadnoughts]], massive warships that were equipped with small [[Superlaser/Legends|superlasers]]. Both of them, the [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']] and later ''[[Eclipse II]]'', were destroyed. The first was consumed by Palpatine's [[Force storm (wormhole)|Force storm]], which he lost control of, and the second was destroyed when [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] set it on a collision course with the [[Galaxy Gun]], another superweapon, similar to the [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']].

==History==
[[File:Dark_empire_map.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A map of the Dark Empire territories and military incursions]]

[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] began planning to replace the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with the Dark Empire sometime prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Imperial Warlords 3">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref>

After Palpatine [[Battle of Endor/Legends|perished]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] at the hands of his former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], the redeemed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], the Emperor's spirit traveled to Byss by possessing [[Jeng Droga]], one of his [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hands]], a process that cost the latter his sanity until he managed to gain a clone body as well as contact [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], who was also partially responsible for his revival.<ref name="tep">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref> The Emperor, needing to recover his strength before resuming his conquest and revealing his revival, observed the crumbling state of his Old Empire from behind the scenes. Likewise, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], although fully aware of Byss's existence, did not know of its connection to Palpatine, and likewise thought it was simply a civilian population, and thus did not investigate it.<ref name="Atlas" /> Palpatine and Pestage were also indirectly responsible for the [[Trioculus affair]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], as they had leaked information about the [[Glove of Darth Vader]] to the [[Rajah Ubooki|false Kadaan]]. The reborn Emperor and the [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] intended to seize the [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]] and use it to boost Palpatine's weakened power and regain control of the galactic stage. In addition, after [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal]]'s presumed death at the [[Battle of Mindor]], it was rumored that Lord Pestage used the late [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Prophet's]] codename and identity of [[Blackhole]] to further push the Dark Empire into open existence.<ref name="SPINblog">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-spy-game-spin-declassified|text=The ''Star Wars'' Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|int=The Star Wars Spy Game: SPIN Declassified|nolive=1}}</ref>

[[File:EmperorsCitadelTEA.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Emperor's Citadel]] on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]], stronghold of the Dark Empire]]

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> having recovered more than enough of his strength, Palpatine eventually decided to reveal himself<ref name="DE 2" /> via summoning a [[Force storm (wormhole)|Force storm]] that resulted in damage to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] &mdash; which had already seen damage from feuding warlords after it was [[Second Battle of Coruscant|reconquered]] by the Empire<ref name="DE 1">[[Dark Empire 1|''Dark Empire'' 1]]</ref> &mdash; although he deliberately didn't stop the mutiny sooner out of revenge, wanting them to "cull the weak."<ref name="Atlas" /> His Force storm also resulted in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] being captured and delivered to Byss. The Emperor then seemingly converted the Jedi Knight into his new Sith apprentice.<ref name="DE 2" /> Anointing Skywalker Vader's replacement as Supreme Commander,<ref name="DE 3" /> Palpatine proceeded to launch an [[Battle of Calamari|attack]] on [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] with his [[World Devastator]]s.<ref name="DE 2" /> In actuality, Skywalker feigned allegiance to Palpatine in order to defeat the dark side from within, and proceeded to leak the override codes for the World Devastators,<ref name="DE 5">[[Dark Empire 5|''Dark Empire'' 5]]</ref> although this did not last long. The Emperor eventually traveled to the New Republic's headquarters, [[Da Soocha V|Pinnacle Moon]], in his flagship, the [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']], and created a Force storm to [[Battle of Pinnacle Base|destroy]] the Pinnacle Moon. However, Palpatine's plan backfired when Skywalker and his sister, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], cut him off from the dark side and had him consumed by his own creation.<ref name="DE 6">[[Dark Empire 6|''Dark Empire'' 6]]</ref>

However, Palpatine proceeded to take over another clone body, although the rest of his clone bodies were destroyed by two traitorous [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] disciples, [[Sa-Di]] and [[Nefta]], and orchestrated [[Operation Shadow Hand]].<ref name="de2 1" /> However, Palpatine suffered a loss of sanity as a result of this brush with death, and utilized the [[Galaxy Gun]] to destroy various targets, eventually cowing several former Imperial worlds into surrendering and having the New Republic scattered.<ref name="Atlas" /> However, several Imperials arranged for [[Carnor Jax]], a member of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]] and Sith apprentice belonging to another [[Lumiya's Sith|Sith sect]], to bribe his [[Emperor's physician|physician]]<ref name="end" /> to tamper with the Emperor's DNA samples to increase the clones' deterioration rate.<ref name="NEC" /> Palpatine was eventually [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|killed]] on Onderon, failing to possess [[Anakin Solo]], and Byss was [[Destruction of Byss|destroyed]] shortly beforehand,<ref name="EE 2">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref> thus not only ending the Dark Empire, but also severely crippling the holdouts of the Galactic Empire beyond any chance of recovery.<ref name="NEC" /> Remaining assets of the Dark Empire were reorganized into the [[Crimson Empire]] led by the self-styled Emperor, Carnor Jax,<ref name="Atlas" /> although it was short-lived thanks to a joint effort by the New Republic and [[Kir Kanos]], the latter intending to avenge Palpatine's death.<ref name="NEC" />

==Politics==
The Dark Empire utilized several portions of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] to enforce the Emperor's will. Unlike the Empire prior to 4 ABY, however, it was openly run by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force users]] (in this case, [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]). The primary method of governance was a dark-side magocracy, where the most powerful Force-wielder (Palpatine) would rule, with several [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] enforcing his will. The Emperor also intended to use the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] alone to attack his enemies, to the extent that he eventually wouldn't even need to rely on [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] to enforce his will.<ref name="endnotes" /> Another difference was that Palpatine designed the Dark Empire to run on autopilot in the event that he was killed before he could do a soul transference, at least while Byss was still in existence.<ref name="Atlas" />

===Military===
Although Palpatine intended to fully replace all superweapons and vessels and solely use dark-side-related methods of enforcing his rule, he was forced to rely on them to defeat the New Republic.<ref name="endnotes" /> Force-related weapons included the [[Shadow Droid]]s, which were biomechanical weapons created with [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]],<ref name="de2 1" /> and [[Chrysalide]]s, which were [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] mutated by Sith alchemy.<ref name="de2 5">[[Dark Empire II 5|''Dark Empire II'' 5]]</ref> [[Imperial Sentinel]]s, mindless bodyguards used by Dark Side Adepts, often accompanied them on missions across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="DSS">''[[Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Non-Force-related weapons and vessels included various capital ships, including the [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']] and ''[[Eclipse II]]'' of the [[Eclipse-class dreadnought|''Eclipse''-class dreadnoughts]], at least one [[Sovereign-class Super Star Destroyer|''Sovereign''-class Super Star Destroyers]], at least four [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnoughts]], at least two [[Vengeance-class dreadnought|''Vengeance''-class dreadnoughts]], at least three [[Mandator III-class dreadnought|''Mandator III''-class dreadnoughts]], at least one [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator''-class dreadnought]], at least five [[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|''Allegiance''-class battlecruisers]] (including the [[Allegiance (Allegiance-class)|''Allegiance'']] itself), at least one [[Secutor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Secutor''-class Star Destroyer]], [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], at least three [[Procursator-class Star Destroyer|''Procursator''-class Star Destroyers]], many [[Modular taskforce cruiser]]s of all varieties, [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]], [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruisers]]. [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]], and [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruisers]], [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigates]], [[Lictor-class dungeon ship|''Lictor''-class dungeon ships]], [[Guardian-class patrol ship|''Guardian''-class patrol ships]], [[Imperial hunter (starship)|Imperial Hunters]], [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]], [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]] and [[Imperial Customs Frigate]]s were also used. It also held a [[Imperial artificial asteroids|asteroid siege platforms]], which where used to [[Battle of Altyr V|attack]] [[Altyr V]]. [[Torpedo Sphere/Legends|Torpedo Spheres]] were also used. Starfighters also included several [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] (including the elite [[Dark Squadron/Legends|Dark Squadron]]), [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]], [[TIE/D automated starfighter]]s, [[I-7 Howlrunner]]s and [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]]s. Security drones likewise included [[Hunter-Killer probot]]s, [[Scorpenek annihilator droid/Legends|Scorpenek annihilator droids]], and [[Shadow Security Droid]]s. It also possessed superweapons, including the [[World Devastator]]s and the [[Galaxy Gun]], as well as the ''Eclipse''-class dreadnoughts' superlasers. The standard infantry for the Dark Empire was the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout troopers]], and [[field stormtrooper]]s. The ground vehicles were [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] (and its [[Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport|aquatic variant]]), [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]], [[TIE crawler/Legends|Century tanks]], [[XR-85 tank droid]]s, [[Reconnaissance Troop Transporter]]s and [[AQ-5 Waveskimmer]]s, and its ground weaponry included the [[X-1 Viper]] "Automadon."

The duties of [[Commander-in-Chief/Legends|commander-in-chief]] of the forces within the Dark Empire were attributed to either the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] or the [[Executor (Imperial rank)|Military Executor]]. During his brief service to Palpatine, Luke Skywalker was granted<ref name="DE 3" /> the position once held by his late father, Darth Vader,<ref name="kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (toy line)|pack=Darth Vader vs. Prince Xizor|link=soteKxizor-vader.asp}}</ref> that of Supreme Commander.<ref name="DE 3" /> Meanwhile, Sedriss QL held the title of Executor;<ref name="de2 1" /> following Sedriss' death in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], Palpatine replaced him with [[Xecr Nist]].<ref name="DEII 4">[[Dark Empire II 4|''Dark Empire II'' 4]]</ref> In addition, the foot soldiers included a variant of the stormtroopers that were amplified by the power of the dark side of the Force, known as [[darktrooper]]s.<ref name="DEII 3">[[Dark Empire II 3|''Dark Empire II'' 3]]</ref> In 10 ABY, when the Dark Empire retook the planet [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], [[SD-9 battle droid]]s were sold to the Imperial arsenal.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dark Empire first appeared in [[Tom Veitch]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series. The empire that the reborn Palpatine ran was not actually given a name when the comic series was released. It wasn't until ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' that it was given a name, which was also the name of the series it originated in. A similar action happened with its successor, the Crimson Empire.

While the Dark Empire is part of [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], an organization known as the [[Final Order]] from the film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] in [[Canon|the current ''Star Wars'' canon]] bears similarities to the organization. As with the Dark Empire, the Final Order was led by a resurrected Emperor [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] and sought to dominate the galaxy like its predecessor, the [[Galactic Empire]], and reestablish [[Sith]] rule. In addition, there was a group of dark side warriors within its ranks ([[Dark Side Elite]]/[[Knights of Ren]]), both have an alternative name with "Empire" in it (the Empire Reborn for the Dark Empire, and both the Sith Empire and the New Empire for the Final Order), both possessed [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|starships equipped with superlasers]] and a [[Final Order|fleet]] tasked with retaking control of the galaxy, from a secret Sith planet ([[Byss/Legends|Byss]]/[[Exegol]]), and both attempted to bring a Jedi over to the dark side ([[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]/[[Rey Skywalker|Rey]]).<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref><ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
